name: curl
title: Transfer data from or to a server
description: Tool to transfer data from or to a server using supported protocols (HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, etc.).

flags.name: -X
flags.description: Specifies a custom request method to use when communicating with the HTTP server.

flags.name: -H
flags.description: Extra header to include in the request when sending HTTP to a server.

flags.name: -d
flags.description: Sends the specified data in an HTTP POST request.

flags.name: -i
flags.description: Include the HTTP response headers in the output.

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Silent or quiet mode. Don't show progress meter or error messages.

examples.explanation: Makes a GET request and prints HTTP headers and response.
Sends a JSON POST payload to an API endpoint.

risk.sideEffects: Performs network I/O; sends request over network.

name: ping
title: Send ICMP ECHO_REQUEST to network hosts
description: Uses ICMP protocol's mandatory ECHO_REQUEST datagram to elicit an ECHO_RESPONSE from a host or gateway.

flags.name: -c
flags.description: Stop after sending count ECHO_REQUEST packets (POSIX).

flags.name: -n
flags.description: Number of echo requests to send (Windows).

examples.explanation: Pings Google Public DNS to verify external network connectivity.
Sends 4 ICMP packets to localhost and prints round-trip statistics.

name: Test-NetConnection
title: Diagnostic tool for network connections (PowerShell)
description: Displays diagnostic information for a connection including TCP port ping, traceroute, and DNS resolution.

examples.explanation: Tests whether outbound TCP connection to github.com on port 443 succeeds.
